name: adaptive-subagent-orchestrator-dev
description: [DEV] Automatic subagent orchestration plugin for complex engineering tasks with independent workstreams.

interface.shortDescription: [DEV] Delegates independent engineering work when parallelism is worthwhile.
interface.longDescription: [DEV] Provides an instruction-only skill that evaluates complex software-engineering requests for independent workstreams, spawns the minimum necessary bounded subagents when the delegation gate passes, and keeps final integration and verification with the main agent.
defaultPrompt: Use adaptive-subagent-orchestrator when a software-engineering task has multiple independent investigation, review, testing, comparison, or implementation workstreams.
Evaluate whether delegation is worthwhile; if it is, spawn the minimum necessary bounded subagents, wait for their evidence, and integrate the final outcome.
